Can I test BeeYield before deciding on full implementation?. If you want to experience how BeeYield works, join our field testing program.. Why does the system use satellite data?.

Satellite data enables the analysis of environmental conditions around the apiary, such as temperature, humidity, weather changes, and the availability of forage for bees.
